name: Lunar
source:
Our protagonist wakes up dazed and confused, where is he? Who is he? For that matter, why is he all covered in fur? Help Red discover his past and hopefully meet a few interesting characters along the way.

[From the [url=https://foofox.furry.nz/Lunar/]official website[/url]]
translation: 我們的主角醒來時頭昏眼花、一頭霧水：這裡是哪裡？他是誰？說起來，他身上為什麼全是毛？幫助Red發現自己的過去，並在途中結識一些有趣的角色吧！[引自[url=https://foofox.furry.nz/Lunar/]官方網站[/url]]
